fallback: live attn / sim-only

&② INVERSION: retention → per-group AUDIO merging ratios
high video retention ⇒ compress that group's audio LESS
_retention_to_per_group_ratios()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

→ audio_mask + merge_plan

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
&④ Apply merge plan
each anchor absorbs softmax-weighted merged tokens
_apply_merge_plan_into_embeds()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
&⑤ Audio-anchored ISTM (video pruning)
even frames: dpcknn · odd frames: temporal novelty
score = −diversity + β·max cos(v_token, audio_anchor)
→ video_mask (β=0 recovers plain OmniZip dpcknn)

global[video_idx]=video_mask; global[audio_idx]=audio_mask
